WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT rental_id, SUM(amount) as total
  FROM payment
  WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rental_id
),
avg_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) as avg
  FROM rental_totals
),
store_rental_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    i.store_id,
    rt.total,
    at.avg
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN rental_totals rt ON r.rental_id = rt.rental_id
  CROSS JOIN avg_total at
)
SELECT 
  store_id,
  SUM(total) as combined_payment_total,
  AVG(total - avg) as avg_beat
FROM store_rental_totals
WHERE total > avg
GROUP BY store_id
